metadata.title: A polynomial bound in Dvoretzky's theorem
metadata.abstract: We present a simple proof of the $\varepsilon$-Dvoretzky conjecture, which asserts that the dependence on the approximation parameter $\varepsilon$ in Dvoretzky's theorem is polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$. In particular, if $n \geq (C/\varepsilon)^{\ell/2+1}$, then any $n$-dimensional convex body has, through any given interior point, an $\ell$-dimensional section that is $\varepsilon$-close to a Euclidean ball. Here, $C > 0$ is a universal constant. We in fact obtain a sharper dependence on $\varepsilon$. The proof is probabilistic, but uses a different probabilistic model from those employed previously. We also prove a simultaneous version of our theorem for a finite family of convex bodies with the origin in their interior, yielding a common linear subspace on which all of the bodies have nearly-Euclidean sections. Finally, we compare the radius of the approximating Euclidean ball with familiar geometric parameters, such as the mean widths of the body and its dual.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: Dvoretzky ε 猜想的多项式界
analysis.workSummary: 在 0<ε<1/2、ℓ≥2 时，以 n≥(C/ε)^((ℓ+1)/2)|log ε| 得到 rB_E⊂K∩E⊂(1+ε)rB_E。先在所有满足 T(B^ℓ)⊂K 的线性算子组成的凸体中均匀抽样，由 Brunn–Minkowski 和 union bound 以至少 1/2 概率得到近椭球截面，再融合 K 与欧氏球对应的子空间分布而获得同维近球截面及有限族同时版本。
analysis.breakthrough: 把近似精度的维数依赖改为 1/ε 的多项式。
analysis.limitations: 子空间分布依赖 K，非 Grassmannian Haar 分布。本文一般凸体的指数 (ℓ+1)/2 是否能降至 (ℓ−1)/2 仍未知；ℓ=2 另有更强的拓扑界。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Grassmannian 上概率分布的想法来自 ChatGPT 与第二作者的讨论；ChatGPT 另用于寻找文献、检查和改进证明及语言编辑。
